newsitem.title: UK: KS Biomedix OA drug enters Phase II trials.
newsitem.headline: KS Biomedix OA drug enters Phase II trials.

text.p: UK biotech company KS Biomedix Holdings Plc said on Monday its new oral combination drug for the treatment of chronic osteoarthritis (OA), CB-2431, had entered Phase II trials.
The randomised, double-blind study is to be performed in nine clinical sites across Europe on 210 patients who have been diagnosed with the condition for at least six months.
The study is expected to be completed in the first quarter of 1998 with final reports available in the third quarter.
